body.name: binary selected-Gaussian coverage functional
body.construction: \(C_z(k)=\int_{-\infty}^{k}\phi(x)g_{\rho_1}(x;z)\,dx+\int_k^{\infty}\phi(x)g_{\rho_2}(x;z)\,dx\), where \(g_{\rho}\) is the conditional probability that a standard normal coordinate correlated by \(\rho\) with \(X=x\) lies in \([-z,z]\).
